conf.description: Forcepoint DLP incident, CSV export tail (Settings > General > Incident Export; a Cribl filesystem/monitor collector tails the rotating export directory). Fixed column order with no header parsed per row, so columns are named positionally. Lowest-fidelity of the three incident feeds - no event time (only an insertion time), no workflow state, no policy names - so it is a fallback for a deployment that cannot enable the REST API or syslog. Preserves the two truncation flags so capped Filenames/Breached contents lists are never read as complete.

functions.description: Parse one exported incident row using the fixed, undocumented-header column order.
Batch-rename every status:mapped column to its ECS target.
Derive event.outcome; split the delimited list columns; relocate unmapped columns and both truncation flags to forcepoint.dlp.*.
Set _time from Insert date - an insertion time, not detection time, no offset (assumed UTC, see README); tag event.dataset.
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
